blind.description: An ornate, gilded pier mirror or standing frame in a stylized classical design. It features an arched reflective mirror pane set within an elaborate gold-painted frame. The top has a decorative sculpted acanthus crest, the side pilasters feature recessed red panels with gold relief details, and the bottom has a matching decorative apron. Surfaces are smooth, solid, and continuous with stylized textures and no floating or broken parts.
blind.from_above: A thin horizontal bar with molded decorative contours, thicker at the side pilasters and cresting in the center.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 to 5 feet tall (reaching roughly shoulder-height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 feet wide.
